about: Every shipped mobile binary and the runtime version baked into it (#1427). The OTA build refuses an update that matches none. Append one entry per store build when it ships: android `unzip -p <aab|apk> base/assets/fingerprint` (APK: assets/fingerprint), ios `Payload/Pollis.app/EXUpdates.bundle/fingerprint` in the IPA. Runbook: mobile/CLAUDE.md -> OTA updates.
